description: This file is a header file (.h) defining interface for managing security daemon groups, including typedefs for handler functions, function prototypes for group lifecycle management, member management, and accessors for group components.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_init
methods.description: Initializes a security daemon group with command, start arguments, and group name.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with a security daemon group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_setEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets event handlers for start argument building, member start condition checking, and runtime actions.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the security daemon group is enabled.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the group is currently running.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_getProc
methods.description: Retrieves the process associated with the group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_getGlSk
methods.description: Gets the global socket handle for the group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_getMembersCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of members in the group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_getActiveMembersCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active members.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_getMemberByPos
methods.description: Gets a group member by position.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_getMemberByName
methods.description: Finds a group member by name.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_hasMember
methods.description: Checks if a specific member exists within the group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_setMemberStartable
methods.description: Sets whether a member is startable.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_dropMembers
methods.description: Removes all members from the group.

ctags.name: isMemberStartableCb
ctags.pattern: /^    wld_secDmnGrp_isMemberStartable isMemberStartableCb;  \/* handler to pre-check starting cond/
